distribution: forest leaf-weighted discrete empirical Mg labels, no CQR; Gaussian Gaia formal parallax error convolution
selection_condition: observed corrected-parallax SNR < 10; all-row PIT F(y)/F(10sigma), subgroup PIT [F(y)-F(lower)]/[F(upper)-F(lower)]
selected_center_null: draw forest-weighted Gaussian observed parallaxes conditional on each source's observed-SNR<10 cut; recompute median(untruncated model mean - simulated observation)
selection_scope: explicit parallax threshold only; DESI/Gaia targeting and quality cuts are additional conditioning
historical_comparator: CQR-expanded five-quantile interpolation, old approximate unconditional PIT, scored on same objects only

selected_center_null.statistic: median(untruncated forest mean - observed corrected parallax)
